title: Learning to Detect Shifts in Unstructured Data Streams via Monitoring-by-Betting
abstract: arXiv:2610.17399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous monitoring of generative AI systems requires detecting distribution shifts in the unstructured data they ingest and generate. Existing monitoring methods typically control false alarms by requiring the discrepancy measure used to detect shifts to be *pre-specified*. However, for unstructured data, pre-specification creates a sensitivity--breadth trade-off: a narrowly defined measure is sensitive to the anticipated shift but may miss unexpected changes, whereas a broadly defined measure may detect a wider range of shifts but with reduced sensitivity. Although adaptively hypothesizing the shift direction can overcome this limitation, such data-dependent adaptation generally invalidates conventional false-alarm guarantees. We reconcile adaptivity with statistical validity through testing-by-betting, reframing sequential changepoint detection as a betting game in which the bettor continually updates its hypothesized shift direct

translated_title: 通过投注式监测学习检测非结构化数据流中的分布偏移
translated_abstract: 对生成式AI系统的持续监控需要检测其输入和生成的非结构化数据中的分布偏移。现有的监控方法通常通过要求预先指定用于检测偏移的差异度量来控制误报。然而，对于非结构化数据，预先指定会造成敏感性—广度之间的权衡：定义狭窄的度量对预期偏移敏感，但可能遗漏意外变化；而定义宽泛的度量虽能检测更广范围的偏移，敏感性却会降低。尽管自适应地假设偏移方向可以克服这一局限，但这种依赖数据的自适应通常会使传统的误报保证失效。我们通过投注式检验将自适应性与统计有效性调和起来，将序贯变点检测重新构建为一场投注博弈，其中投注者不断更新其假设的偏移方向。
tldr: 提出一种基于投注式检验的监控框架，通过将序贯变点检测建模为投注博弈并自适应更新偏移方向假设，解决了非结构化数据流分布偏移检测中敏感性与广度的权衡问题，同时保持误报率的统计保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a monitoring-by-betting framework that reframes sequential changepoint detection as a betting game with adaptively updated shift direction hypotheses, resolving the sensitivity-breadth trade-off in detecting distribution shifts in unstructured data streams while preserving statistical false-alarm guarantees.
